criteria.BACKWARD_COMPATIBLE: field additions or implementation substitutions preserving owner, semantics, evidence contract, trace and guards
criteria.REQUIRES_TARGETED_REGRESSION: affected stage contract or integration-only adapter changes without downstream shape change
criteria.REQUIRES_FULL_REGRESSION: owner, canonical evidence, candidate/truth, trace, mutation or negative guard boundary changes
criteria.BREAKING_CHANGE: incompatible type/semantic/lifecycle change requiring a new version
criteria.BLOCKED_CHANGE: change violates owner, network, execution, truth or mutation policy
